purpose: Close E1 heterogeneous-20 low, middle, and high with NSESche-only fresh held-out trials against immutable twenty-seed formal baseline thresholds.

fresh_nsesche_cohort.pre_registration_check: No exact E240-E249 artifact existed in either the development or frozen-artifact repository before this plan was written.

mechanistic_basis.workflow_order: All candidates use the frozen outcome-blind shortest-remaining-workflow-first order over the parent-complete ready frontier.
mechanistic_basis.low: The formal heterogeneous low-load throughput and QPR leaders are OCS and Hiku, so the candidate path spans their pure endpoints, equal Borda, and the already closed homogeneous low two-Hiku-to-one-OCS placement vote.
mechanistic_basis.middle: The formal heterogeneous middle-load throughput and QPR leaders are FaaSRank and Load Balance, so the candidate path includes their frozen pure experts and equal ordinal Borda, plus the closed homogeneous middle Hiku-to-three-OCS transfer anchor.
mechanistic_basis.high: The formal heterogeneous high-load throughput and QPR leaders are Hiku and OCS, so the candidate path spans their pure endpoints, equal Borda, and a two-Hiku-to-one-OCS compromise.
mechanistic_basis.information_boundary: Expert scores use only current preplacement state and frozen model/history inputs; no seed label, workload label, completion, latency, cost, throughput, QPR, or baseline threshold enters online routing.

candidates.definition: Transfer the already frozen homogeneous-20 winner for each load without modification.
Use the placement expert corresponding to the frozen heterogeneous throughput leader for each load.
Use the frozen heterogeneous QPR leader at low/middle and the equal Hiku/OCS compromise at high.
Use equal ordinal Borda across the load's distinct throughput/QPR experts at low/middle and a two-Hiku-to-one-OCS high-load compromise.

selection.gate: For each load independently, a candidate's five-seed arithmetic mean must be strictly greater than the frozen twenty-seed nine-baseline maximum for all three metrics.
selection.multiple_passers: Choose the passing candidate with the largest minimum relative margin across the three frozen thresholds; tie-break by candidate_id.
selection.failed_load_action: Retain every trial as audit evidence, keep only that load open, and do not inspect or consume E245-E249 without a separately committed plan.
